questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Welcome back to school. How do you feel today? Did you sleep ⓐ well last night? Sleeping well can give you ⓑ energy for the new school year. Now, check your sleep habits with the list. How many habits did you check? These habits may ⓒ cause sleep problems. Do you think you need a ⓓ change? Let's find out what to ⓔ continue.
questions.explanation: ⓔ continue는 문맥상 부적절합니다. 'find out what to do'(무엇을 해야 하는지 알아보자)가 맞는 표현이므로 'continue'가 아닌 'do'가 와야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little ⓐ tired, and you will fall asleep ⓑ easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right ⓒ before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep ⓓ easily. Stop using your smartphone before bedtime. If you use your smartphone late at night, your brain will stay ⓔ inactive. The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet."
questions.explanation: ⓔ inactive는 문맥상 부적절합니다. 스마트폰의 블루 라이트가 뇌를 깨운다는 내용이므로 'active'(활성화된)가 맞는 표현입니다.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

주어진 문장: Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime.

Be careful about caffeine. Caffeine can cause sleep problems. ( ① ) Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? ( ② ) Caffeine hides in many foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks. So, be careful! Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. ( ③ ) Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. ( ④ ) If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep easily. ( ⑤ )
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장 'Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime.'은 '낮 동안 운동을 한다'는 내용 다음에 와야 하므로 ③번 위치가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓔ에 들어갈 말이 올바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Have a regular sleep pattern. Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. (a)____ example, in the morning, your body starts to feel lively. (b)____ night, your body starts to feel sleepy. Listen (c)____ your body clock and sleep regularly. You will feel healthier. Be careful (d)____ caffeine. Caffeine can cause sleep problems. Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? Caffeine hides in many foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks. (e)____, be careful!
questions.explanation: (a) For example(예를 들어) (b) At night(밤에) (c) Listen to(~을 듣다) (d) Be careful about(~을 조심하다) (e) So(그래서)

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily (A) ________ night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel (B) ________ awake. You may not fall asleep easily. Stop using your smartphone before bedtime. If you use your smartphone late at night, your brain will stay active. The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet." To sleep well, don't use your phone right before bedtime.
questions.explanation: (A) at night(밤에) (B) too awake(너무 깨어있는)

options: Leo에게 여자는 배드민턴을 치자고 먼저 제안했다.
두 사람은 이번 주말에 배드민턴을 칠 것이다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

G: Leo, do you have any special goals for this year?
B: Yes, I'm planning to exercise more.
G: Good for you! What kind of exercise do you want to do?
B: I want to play badminton. Do you like badminton?
G: Yes, I love it. Let's play together sometime.
B: Sure!
questions.explanation: 대화에서 여자(G)가 'Yes, I love it'이라고 배드민턴을 매우 좋아한다고 표현했습니다.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

주어진 문장: Caffeine hides in many foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks.

Have a regular sleep pattern. Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel lively. At night, your body starts to feel sleepy. ( ① ) Listen to your body clock and sleep regularly. ( ② ) You will feel healthier. Be careful about caffeine. Caffeine can cause sleep problems. ( ③ ) Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? ( ④ ) So, be careful! ( ⑤ )
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장은 'chocolate has caffeine'이라는 문장 다음에 와서 '카페인이 많은 식품들을 설명'하는 내용이므로 ④번 위치가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 쓴 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Welcome back to school. How do you feel today? Did you sleep well last night? Sleeping well can give you energy for the new school year. Now, check your sleep habits with the list.

I ...
□ go to bed at different times
□ drink a lot of energy drinks
□ use my smartphone before sleeping
□ sleep less than 8 hours a day
□ eat before bedtime
□ take long naps

How many habits did you check? These habits may cause sleep problems. Do you think you need a change? Let's find out what to do.
questions.explanation: 글에서 수면 습관 체크리스트를 제시하고, 나쁜 습관을 확인한 후 변화가 필요한지 생각해보고 해결책을 찾도록 권유하고 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep (A) [easily / late] at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours (B) [before / after] bedtime. If you finish it right (C) [before / after] bedtime, your body may feel too awake.
questions.explanation: (A) easily(쉽게) - 피곤하면 쉽게 잔다 (B) before(전에) - 자기 몇 시간 전에 운동을 끝내야 한다 (C) after(후에) - 잠들기 직후가 아니라 전에 운동을 끝내야 한다는 대조 표현

questions.question:
주어진 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 어휘로 가장 적절한 것을 고르면?

Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little (A) [tired / awake], and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too (B) [asleep / awake]. You may not fall asleep easily. Stop using your smartphone before bedtime. If you use your smartphone late at night, your brain will stay (C) [active / calm]. The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet." To sleep well, don't use your phone right before bedtime.
questions.explanation: (A) tired(피곤한) - 운동하면 피곤해진다 (B) awake(깨어있는) - 자기 전에 운동하면 너무 깨어있게 된다 (C) active(활성화된) - 스마트폰의 블루라이트가 뇌를 활성화시킨다

options: 잠을 잘 자는 것이 왜 좋은가?
체크리스트에 제시된 나쁜 수면 습관은 총 몇 개인가?
신체 시계는 아침에 우리 몸을 어떻게 느끼게 하는가?
규칙적인 수면 패턴을 가지면 어떤 점이 좋은가?
신체 시계를 건강하게 유지하기 위해 먹어야 할 음식은 무엇인가?
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?

Welcome back to school. How do you feel today? Did you sleep well last night? Sleeping well can give you energy for the new school year. Now, check your sleep habits with the list.

I ...
□ go to bed at different times
□ drink a lot of energy drinks
□ use my smartphone before sleeping
□ sleep less than 8 hours a day
□ eat before bedtime
□ take long naps

How many habits did you check? These habits may cause sleep problems. Do you think you need a change? Let's find out what to do.

Have a regular sleep pattern. Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel lively. At night, your body starts to feel sleepy. Listen to your body clock and sleep regularly. You will feel healthier.
questions.explanation: 글에서 신체 시계를 건강하게 유지하기 위해 먹어야 할 음식에 대한 내용은 나오지 않습니다. 다른 선택지들은 모두 글에서 찾을 수 있습니다.

options: 낮에 운동하는 것이 잠에 좋은 이유는 무엇인가?
낮에 어떤 종류의 운동을 하는 것이 가장 좋은가?
잠자기 직전에 운동하면 왜 잠들기 어려운가?
questions.question:
[지문]
Be careful about caffeine.
Caffeine can cause sleep problems. Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? Caffeine hides in many foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks. So, be careful!

Move your body actively.
Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep easily.

다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
questions.explanation: 낮에 어떤 종류의 운동을 해야 하는지는 지문에 명시되어 있지 않습니다. 지문은 '낮에 운동하라'는 조언만 있을 뿐, 특정한 운동 종류는 언급하지 않습니다.

options: 진수는 자신의 독서 습관을 공유함으로써 니콜을 격려하고 있다.
니콜은 진수의 목표가 자신의 목표보다 더 야심 차다고 생각한다.
진수는 니콜의 작년 실패가 꾸준함이 부족했기 때문이라고 제안한다.
니콜은 반장 및 훌륭한 리더로서의 경험이 있다.
진수는 니콜이 더 작은 독서 목표를 세워야 한다고 생각한다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Jinsu: Nicole, what are your goals for this year?
Nicole: I'm planning to read 30 books. I tried last year but didn't make it.
Jinsu: That's a big goal.
Nicole: Yes, I really want to do it this time.
Jinsu: You can do it! Just read a little every day.
Nicole: Okay, I will. What are your goals, Jinsu?
Jinsu: I'm planning to run for the election. I want to become class president.
Nicole: You're good at listening to people. You'll be a great leader.

다음 대화를 읽고 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 진수가 "Just read a little every day"라고 조언하는 것으로부터, 니콜의 작년 실패가 꾸준함(consistency)이 부족했기 때문이라고 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

① Hi, everyone! I'm Hans from Germany. Do you ride a bike often? ② In my country, we have bike classes at school. We also have a road safety test to ride a bike on the road. ③ This Saturday, I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister. ④ Germany is also well-known for its automotive industry and sausages. ⑤ She's going to have the road safety test soon, so we will practice together. Do you have any special plans for the weekend? I'd love to hear from you.
questions.explanation: "Germany is also well-known for its automotive industry and sausages"는 자전거와 도로 안전 테스트에 대한 주제와 무관한 내용입니다. 전체 흐름은 자전거 타기와 안전 테스트 연습에 관한 것이므로, 독일의 자동차 산업과 소시지에 대한 언급은 맥락에 맞지 않습니다.

B: Who is Minji?
G: She is the guitarist in the school band.

options: 잠자기 직전에 운동하면 쉽게 잠들 수 있다.
늦은 밤에 스마트폰을 사용하면 뇌가 쉬게 된다.
잠을 잘 자려면 잠자기 직전에 스마트폰을 사용해야 한다.
낮에 운동하는 것은 몸을 너무 깨어있게 만든다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Move your body actively.
Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep easily.

Stop using your smartphone before bedtime.
If you use your smartphone late at night, your brain will stay active. The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet." To sleep well, don't use your phone right before bedtime.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: 두 번째 문단에서 "The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, 'Hey, don't sleep yet.'"(폰에서 나오는 블루라이트는 또한 당신의 뇌에 '이봐, 아직 자지 마.'라고 말할 것이다.)라고 했으므로, 이 글의 내용과 일치한다. 1번: 잠자기 직전에 운동하면 몸이 너무 깨어있게 된다. 2번: 뇌가 활발한 상태(active)를 유지한다. 4번: 잠을 잘 자려면 잠자기 직전에 스마트폰을 '사용하지 말아야 한다'. 5번: 낮에 운동하는 것은 몸을 '약간 피곤하게'(a little tired) 만든다.
